extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，it is unnecessary to bring any documents 是告訴員工：新線上表單取代紙本，所以不必親自帶文件到人資部，語氣是方便、省事的提醒。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用句型 it is unnecessary (for + 人) to + V，to 後面接原形動詞。

example.en: Printing the report twice was more unnecessary than we first thought.
example.zh: 把報告印兩次，比我們原先想的更沒有必要。

example.en: Cutting the training budget was the most unnecessary decision we made this year.
example.zh: 削減訓練預算是我們今年最沒必要的決定。

example.en: The old process unnecessarily delayed every request by several days.
example.zh: 舊流程不必要地把每份申請延遲了好幾天。

example.en: We should avoid unnecessary costs during the busy season.
example.zh: 旺季期間，我們應該避免不必要的成本。

example.en: Please submit the form today to prevent unnecessary delay.
example.zh: 請今天就送出表格，以免不必要的延誤。

example.en: It is unnecessary to call us if the system is working.
example.zh: 如果系統運作正常，就不必打電話給我們。

example.en: Try to avoid unnecessary meetings so that the team can focus.
example.zh: 請盡量避免不必要的會議，讓團隊能專心。

examples.en: It is unnecessary to print the form; you can submit it online.
examples.zh: 不必列印表格，您可以在線上提交。

examples.en: The extra step proved unnecessary and slowed down the whole process.
examples.zh: 多出來的這個步驟被證明沒必要，還拖慢了整個流程。

similar.diff: needless 較書面，常修飾 expense、delay 等名詞；unnecessary 更常用，也能用在 It is unnecessary to ... 句型。

example.en: The new system will reduce needless paperwork in the office.
example.zh: 新系統將減少辦公室裡不必要的文書作業。

similar.diff: not required 是較白話的「不需要」，強調規定上不要求；unnecessary 強調「沒有必要」。

example.en: A signature is not required for deliveries under fifty dollars.
example.zh: 五十美元以下的包裹不需要簽收。

example.en: Attendance at the safety training is required for all staff.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須參加安全訓練。

example.en: The extra workshop is optional but strongly recommended.
example.zh: 額外的工作坊是自由參加，但強烈建議出席。

example.en: Clear communication is essential for any successful project.
example.zh: 清楚的溝通對任何成功的專案都不可或缺。

example.en: There is no extra charge for online payments.
example.zh: 線上付款不收額外費用。

derived.link: necessary 是詞幹；加上 un-（不）就變成 unnecessary，像 happy → unhappy
necessary 去 -ary 加 -ity，變成名詞，像 able → ability
